Observability by design
Persist decisions, selected tools/agents, policy outcomes, citations, provenance, confidence/quality signals and tool activity — never private model chain-of-thought.

A2A boundary
Use A2A only when the specialist is a separately deployed registered agent. In-process subagents can use local ADK/runtime calls.

Tool / data boundary
Specialists call governed tools and data sources via approved connectors/APIs/MCP. Tool calls carry scoped identity, policy context and audit metadata.

Security & governance
All actions are identity-scoped, policy-checked, and audit-logged. Evidence and results carry provenance and lineage for compliance and explainability.
